data.one_liner: A customizable neon‑styled circular countdown timer widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular timer with neon and optional neumorphic effects. You can control it via a CountDownController to start, pause, resume or restart, and customize colors, gradients, text style and visibility.
use_when: You need a visually rich countdown timer in a Flutter app
You want quick UI with neon or neumorphic styling without building it from scratch
avoid_when: You require complex timing logic beyond start/pause/reset
You need platform‑specific timer integrations or background execution
strengths: Highly customizable appearance (neon, gradients, neumorphic border)
Simple controller API for timer actions
weaknesses: Limited to visual countdown; no built‑in persistence or background handling
Only one timer per widget instance

alternatives.name: percent_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides circular percent/timer indicators with less visual flair but broader community support

data.minimal_example:
NeonCircularTimer(
  width: 200,
  duration: 20,
  controller: myController,
  isTimerTextShown: false,
  neumorphicEffect: true,
  innerFillGradient: LinearGradient(colors: [Colors.greenAccent.shade200, Colors.blueAccent.shade400]),
  neonGradient: LinearGradient(colors: [Colors.greenAccent.shade200, Colors.blueAccent.shade400]),
);
